//: Type-checks the agent's tests, including the edge-function handler tests.
Separate from the build because those tests import files under
supabase/functions, which sit outside this package's rootDir and must not
end up in dist. noEmit, so nothing is produced.
allowImportingTsExtensions is on because the edge functions are Deno code
and Deno requires explicit .ts extensions on relative imports. This lets
tsc read the same files Deno will run.
